introHtml: Heat transfer decoration gives you full-color, photo-quality logos on performance fabrics without the stiffness of embroidery. It is ideal for small runs or complex designs on polyester tees, hoodies, and jackets. Marketing directors and safety managers choose heat transfer for quick-turn corporate events or uniform updates where every detail must pop.
